source_differences: Magnitudes vary: Wikipedia list 5.7, dlib/Geologija Mhv 5.6, Mw 5.6, Ms 5.7, WCEE 5.8, ASMI MD 5.6.
Epicentre: 46.309 N, 13.632 E at 7.6 km depth (Geologija, dLib) against 46.320 N, 13.663 E at about 10 km (WCEE), about 2.6 km apart.
Intensity: Wikipedia/dlib VII-VIII EMS, ASMI VIII-IX MCS.
Epicentre and magnitude of 12 April 1998: 46.309° N, 13.632° E, depth 7.6 km, Mw 5.6 (dlib.si) against 46.320 13.663, magnitude 5.8, focal depth about 10 km (wcee.nicee.org)
